name: GameSir Cloned Mode — two outputs, same time
intent: One physical button duplicates its mapped function: two on-screen targets fire together on press and on release.
ios_limitation: Apple blocked third-party mapping from iOS 13.4. GameSir World has no game library or Cloned Mode on iPhone/iPad.
zh_menu: 点击模式 → 两个完全一样的按钮，按下/弹起同时响应
vi_menu: Click Mode / 点击模式 → Cloned Mode
how_to_edit: Launch the game from GameSir World with G-Touch or V-Touch mapping enabled.
Tap the floating GameSir icon → Adjust buttons / 调整键位.
Select the mapped button → tap ⚙️ (or double-tap the overlay button).
Set Click Mode to Cloned Mode. Two identical child buttons appear.
Drag each child onto a different HUD target. Save / 保存外设.
To retarget later: reopen 调整键位 and drag the two children; do not switch mode.
To disable: ⚙️ → Click Mode → Normal, or delete the button and remap.

keys.notes: Both clone children must occupy real screen coordinates. Overlapping them on the same pixel is a Normal tap, not a useful clone.

not_cloned.why: Single target, single tap. No second output to edit.

not_cloned.vi_menu: Separated press & release / 按下弹起分离
not_cloned.why: Two targets, but press taps the first and release taps the second. Not simultaneous.
Repeats one target. Does not duplicate onto a second spot.
Timed sequence. Interval 0s can look like a clone but it is a different editor (add child keys, record timing).
Copies a HID button value onto a back paddle. The game sees two controller buttons, not two screen touches.

verify.gamesir_tool: Test / 测试 inside 调整键位
expect: Press the bound button: two touch markers appear at the same instant.
Release the bound button: both markers fire again together (clone is press and release).
Separated mode would show marker 1 on press and marker 2 only on release.
